gancho: Pele wants Lohiʻau brought to her, but all her sisters are afraid to go. Only the youngest, Hiʻiaka, says yes: forty days, and she must not touch him. In return, Pele swears to protect Hiʻiaka's lehua forest and her best friend Hōpoe. Hiʻiaka sets out with a skirt full of lightning. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), W. D. Westervelt (1916) and Martha Beckwith (1940).
